name: LootboxSpawnArea - Default (seed v1)
description: A lootbox spawn area: a WorldGuard region where world boxes appear, with its spawn rules and allowed box types. Also created in game with /knk lootbox area create, which opens in this form too.

steps.description: Name the area and pick its WorldGuard region. For a new region, /knk lootbox area create <name> in game is simplest; here, use Send to Minecraft and type select <region> to use an existing one.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: 1-32 letters, digits, _ or -, unique. The in-game /knk lootbox area commands use it.

fields.label: Region
fields.description: Boxes appear on the ground anywhere inside this region. Prefer an existing region (select <region>): one drawn here gets a temporary name, is only as high as your selection, and the server removes it after 14 days.

fields.label: World
fields.description: The world the region is in, exactly as the server names it (shown in the region result above). Boxes only spawn there when the name matches.

fields.label: Excluded regions
fields.description: Comma-separated WorldGuard region ids inside the area where boxes must not appear, such as plots or buildings. At most 1024 characters.

steps.description: When the server tries to spawn a box here. Every try waits the full interval, whether a box appears or not.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Only enabled areas spawn boxes. Turn it on once the region and allowed types are set.

fields.label: Try every (seconds)
fields.description: Time between spawn tries, at least 60.

fields.label: Spawn chance (%)
fields.description: Chance that a try spawns a box, 0-100.

fields.label: Minimum players online
fields.description: No tries while fewer players are on the server. 0 = always.

steps.description: How many boxes the area holds at once, how close to players they may appear, and how long they last.

fields.label: Maximum boxes at once
fields.description: No new box while this many are waiting in the area (0 or more). The global limit in the lootbox settings applies as well.

fields.label: Minimum distance from players (blocks)
fields.description: A spot closer than this to any player is skipped, so boxes don't appear in front of someone. 0 = anywhere.

fields.label: Box lifetime (minutes)
fields.description: A box nobody picks up crumbles after this time, at least 1.

steps.description: Which box types may spawn here. Leave it empty to allow every enabled type.

fields.label: Allowed box types
fields.description: Create New Join Entry adds a type; types are picked by their spawn weight.
